instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium shot captures an indoor study room. On the left, the woman in the beige pantsuit (R2) stands upright, smiling in profile. On the right, the man in the blue turtleneck (R1) stands fully upright, looking down slightly at her with a smile. They clasp right hands in a handshake over a wooden table in the foreground, which holds a Scrabble board and books. The man holds a smartphone in his left hand. Warm, soft indoor lighting illuminates the scene, creating a cozy and welcoming atmosphere.
